falsification_conditions.condition: SPY closes above 520.00 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 73% pattern match to March 2024 ETF top would be invalidated, as that pattern resolved with lower highs; a breakout above 520 would confirm bull continuation, not distribution

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 12.50 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score of 60 typically coincides with elevated complacency already reversing; sustained sub-12.50 VIX would indicate the complacency hasn't peaked and the 'HOLD' signal was premature—no fear event is materializing

falsification_conditions.condition: Total ETF outflows exceed $15 billion in any single week (per ICI or Bloomberg fund flow data)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The pattern match suggests controlled distribution; a sudden $15B+ weekly outflow would indicate panic liquidation rather than orderly topping, breaking the structural similarity to March 2024's gradual rollover

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
